events.title: TVS Club Meeting
Public Star Party at Sunol Regional Wilderness
events.description:
Public star party at Sunol Regional Wilderness. Set up 6:45.  Observing starts 7:30 pm, ends about 9:30 or 10 pm. Map to the parking lot we will be setting up in https://maps.app.goo.gl/sGxWWiah37SY7rhN8. Moon is a few days past new, and Saturn will be rising early in the evening. Please let me know if you are planning on bringing a telescope or binoculars to share with the public.
 
Thanks,
Johnathan Bailey

events.title: Stargazing at the Livermore Library
events.description: Stargazing at the Livermore library. They said we can start setting up after 5, though that is pretty early. Let's start set up at 6. Presentation starts at 6:30 pm. I will take any volunteer for that, or I will do the presentation myself. Telescope stuff starts about 7 pm.
events.location: Livermore Library 1188 S Livermore Ave, Livermore, CA 94550

events.title: School Star Party at John Green Elementary
events.description: School star party at John Green Elementary. Set up at 6:30 or 6:45 and observing starts near dark at 7:30. Nearly full moon and Saturn is rising.
events.location: John Green Elementary School, 3300 Antone Way, Dublin

events.title: School Star Party at Murray Elementary School
events.description:
School star party at Murray Elementary. They had a good blacktop that we could drive out to last time. Set up 6:30 observing once Saturn is visible until about 9:30. Please let me know if you can make it.
 
Thanks,
Johnathan
events.location: Murray Elementary School, 8435 Davona Dr, Dublin, CA 94568
